verdict: Spend collapsed to $3.85 on the latest day from a $13.63 average — the campaign is stalling.
diagnosis: Only one active campaign ran this period, burning $2,330 against a niche PCOS and postpartum audience with no lead or conversion data flowing back.

signals.headline: Daily spend fell 72% to $3.85
signals.detail: Latest day sits far below the 28-day average of $13.63, suggesting budget pacing or delivery issues worth checking today.

signals.headline: 346,446 impressions on $2,330 spend
signals.detail: Reach volume looks healthy for a niche persona, but without lead data we cannot confirm quality or cost per lead.

signals.headline: One campaign carrying 100% of spend
signals.detail: Single-campaign dependency on the PCOS and postpartum angle leaves no backup if creative fatigues or audience saturates.

signals.headline: Zero visibility across 3 channels
signals.detail: No Google Business Profile, organic social, or pipeline data reported this period, blocking any read on lead quality or booked trials.

benchmark.label: Benchmark
benchmark.body: Premium and boutique fitness studios typically pay between $25 and $52 per lead on Meta in 2026. Personal training specifically sits at the top of that range.

seasonal.label: Seasonal
seasonal.subheader: Fall is a strong lead window
seasonal.body: Fitness cost per lead on Meta trended down roughly 20% year over year in 2026. Autumn sits well below the July peak of around $48 per lead.

competitor.label: Category
competitor.subheader: Fitness converts best of any industry
competitor.body: Fitness posts a 14.29% conversion rate on Meta, the highest of any tracked category. Short-form video of real members and fast lead follow-up are the two biggest levers right now.

recommendations.title: Investigate the sudden drop in daily spend
recommendations.detail: Check whether the campaign hit budget caps, lost delivery, or had payment issues. Latest day at $3.85 suggests something broke rather than a planned pullback.

recommendations.title: Connect lead and pipeline data before scaling
recommendations.detail: Without cost per lead or trial bookings visible, spending decisions are blind. Consider wiring form submissions and booked trials into reporting this week.

recommendations.title: Test a second creative angle alongside PCOS persona
recommendations.detail: A single persona campaign is fragile. Worth testing short vertical video of real members or a general trial offer to compare cost per lead.
